g.text: Two crystal balls: bound the threshold, then scan
16 indices, jump = floor(sqrt(16)) = 4. F = safe; T = breaks.
Safe at 8; break at 12. The threshold lies in (8, 12].
Second ball: the project scan includes the safe lower boundary, index 8.
Check 8: safe -> check 9: safe -> check 10: breaks; return 10.
If a jump passes the array end, scan the remaining partial block instead.
